title: KV-cache Quantization Stability Audit Playbook
author: Sofia Martinez
summary: Playbook for auditing behavioral stability when applying quantization to models that rely heavily on KV-cache and prefix reuse. Defines checks, data sets, metrics, and automated harness steps to detect subtle regressions introduced by quantized kernels interacting with cached key/value tensors.
background: Quantization reduces model size and inference cost but can change numerical behavior. Models that use long-lived KV-cache (e.g., multi-turn chat, code generation with prefix reuse) are sensitive to small numerical differences that may accumulate across tokens or across cache merges. This playbook codifies deterministic tests, divergence thresholds, and remediation paths for onboarding quantized variants into production serving profiles.
scope: Applies to: 1) all encoder-decoder and decoder-only model families deployed with KV-cache support on Redwood serving runtime; 2) quantization paths that change kernel precision (int8, fp8-like hybrids, per-channel scales). Excludes: models run without cache, or purely embedding/transformation-only pipelines.
definitions: KV-cache: per-layer key/value tensors cached between tokens/requests.
Stepwise divergence: difference in model outputs measured at each token step compared with baseline.
Drift accumulation: growing divergence over token positions that exceeds tolerance.
Quantized variant: a model binary with reduced-precision kernels or reduced-precision weights.
prerequisites:
- Baseline (float32) golden traces for representative prompt sets (see Test Data).
- Access to the quantized artifact and corresponding model config.
- Access to the eval harness and runtime profiling tools (rwi-harness, kv-checker).
- Sufficient test hardware: same GPU family as target production or nearest equivalent.
test_data_and_sets: We use three orthogonal prompt suites: 1) Prefix Continuity (multi-turn chat transcripts with long context reuse). 2) Deterministic Prefix Merge (programming prompts with repeated include/append sequences). 3) Stochastic Generation Stress (creative generation with temperature exposing probabilistic shifts). Each suite contains 200–1,000 seeds across short/medium/long contexts. Store golden traces in /datasets/quant-audit/golden/<model-name>/<suite>/.
test_matrix_and_thresholds_table:
| Dimension | Metric | Baseline | Warning | Fail |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Per-token KL | mean KL at step t | 0.0 (ref) | > 0.004 | >= 0.01 |
| Top-1 Match | fraction tokens where argmax matches baseline | 1.00 | < 0.995 | <= 0.98 |
| BLEU/ROUGE (det prompts) | score vs baseline over whole response | baseline | -1.5 pts | -3.0 pts |
| Latency delta | p95 token latency increase | baseline | > +10% | > +25% |
| Drift slope | linear regression slope of KL over token pos | 0.0 | > 1e-4 | > 5e-4 |
procedures:
1) Preparation: a) Register quantized artifact in eval harness registry with unique tag. b) Ensure golden traces available and runtime seed parity.
2) Warm-up run: Execute 50 short-context traces to prime caches and validate runtime correctness flags.
3) Token-by-token comparison: For each prompt in suite, stream generation from baseline and quantized variant with identical sampling seeds. Collect per-token logits/softmax, top-k lists, and KV snapshots at checkpoint layers.
4) Metric aggregation: Compute per-token KL, top-1 match, and full-response similarity metrics. Generate time-series plots of KL vs token position and of cumulative mismatch.
5) Drift detection: Flag traces where any metric crosses Fail thresholds or where 3+ Warning conditions appear across the suite.
6) Root-cause data collection: For flagged traces collect layer-wise QKV norms, single-step Jacobian estimates (finite differences), and kernel execution traces including tiling/packing decisions.
7) Triage: Map failures to categories (numerical rounding, kernel bug, cache-merge mismatch, seeding/PRNG). Assign owner and severity.
8) Remediation loop: iterate on quantization config (per-channel scale, clip thresholds, mixed-precision fallback for attention layers), rerun targeted subset, and promote when metrics are within Warning band for 48h and Fail-free on full suite.
automated_harness_commands:
# Example harness snippets (rwi-harness)
# register artifact
rwi-harness register --model=my-model --tag=quant-v1 --artifact s3://artifacts/quant-v1.pt

# run audit suite (parallelized)
rwi-harness run-audit --model-tag=quant-v1 --suite=prefix-continuity --out=results/quant-v1/prefix

# export per-token diffs to CSV
rwi-harness export-diffs --input=results/quant-v1 --format=csv --out=artifacts/quant-v1-diffs.csv

# compute aggregate alerts
rwi-harness summarize --input=results/quant-v1 --thresholds=playbook-defaults.yaml --out=report.pdf
example_config_snippet:
# sample quant-audit config (YAML)
model: my-model
baseline_tag: float32-golden
variant_tag: quant-v1
suites:
  - prefix_continuity
  - deterministic_merge
  - stochastic_stress
sampling:
  seed: 42
  temperature: 0.0 # deterministic compare
thresholds_path: playbook-defaults.yaml
collect:
  kv_snapshots: true
  per_layer_stats: true
  kernel_traces: true
parallelism: 64
expected_metrics_and_actions: If 'Fail' appears: freeze rollout, open SEV ticket, attach audit report and layer-dumps; revert to previous serving profile.
If only 'Warning' band triggers on <5% of traces: continue with canary limited to 5% traffic for 24h with increased monitoring and daily re-eval.
If latency regressions >10%: consider mixed-precision for attention and key layers or adjust packing to reduce kernel overhead.
common_failure_modes_and_signatures: Monotonic KL growth localized to deeper layers: indicates per-channel scale computation error.
Sparse sudden mismatches at merge points: sign of cache-merge ordering divergence (check token indexing offsets).
Uniform small bias across tokens: quantization zero-point or asymmetric quantization miscalibration.
Intermittent mismatches that correlate with certain batch sizes: kernel tiling/packing edge case.
remediation_playbook:
- Recompute per-channel scales with calibration set and symmetric clipping; retest.
- Re-run quantize with attention layers in fp16 (mixed-precision) and validate latency/accuracy tradeoffs.
- Apply kernel patch toggles (packing alignment) and re-run warm-up and targeted regressions.
- If non-numeric bug suspected, capture kernel logs and escalate to serving-runtime team with reproducible test-case and KV snapshots.
rollout_and_safety_controls:
- Canary policy: 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%, minimum 24h per step and must be Fail-free on targeted canary suite.
- Auto-rollback trigger: any Fail or >0.5% user-visible error increase reported by runtime telemetry.
- Monitoring hooks: token-level discrepancy rate, p95 latency delta, and customer-facing error rates.
ownership_and_escalation: Primary owner: model-serving (quantization) squad. Secondary: runtime-kernels team. Escalation path: owner -> runtime lead -> eng-director -> on-call SRE if outage suspected. Include audit report and trace IDs in pager message.
appendix:
- Storage: keep raw KV snapshots and per-token logits for 90 days under secure bucket.
- Repro notes: always fix seeds, match tokenizers and BPE merges to baseline artifact.
- Audit reporting template available at /templates/quant-audit-report.md
